planned_arguments.prompt:
Create ONE finished flat opaque landscape 16:9 promotional poster for a neighborhood repair workshop, intended for SNS and local community display. Single continuous documentary COLOR PHOTOGRAPH with crisp professionally printed typography over it. Full bleed, no mockup, frame, comparison panels or alternative images. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력.

Input image 1 is a newly made planning guide for the central reading route, paragraph area and type anatomy ONLY. Convert its simple people and objects into substantial real photographic repair action. Do not reproduce its gray palette, clipart figures, diagram lines or passive shapes. Its coordinates are adaptable; retain its opening between working bodies and gently descending left optical edge, readable paragraph and adjoining event/registration run. No claim of applying its font file is needed.

One shared accomplishment through contact: FOUR adult Korean neighbors work at the SAME worn wooden bench in ONE coherent current encounter. Two repair a large recognizable loose wooden chair on the left near edge. Two repair a large torn cotton shirt on the right. Quiet directional daylight, deep indigo work clothes with worn sleeves, warm natural skin, golden worn wood, pale cotton, observant concentration. Photographic detail, ordinary lived-in workshop without signage, real human proportions and distinct natural hands. Continuous tabletop grain, shared light and consistent contact shadows connect all four people, chair and shirt. No collage strips or isolated floating objects.

Camera slightly elevated above elbow height, wide close view. Upper left and upper right neighbors have legible bent heads and shoulders; the nearer left and right neighbors have visible heads and arms and their bodies crop into the lower edges. Large bodies and recognizable objects continue toward the edges and form the central opening. Left chair visibly includes back slats, seat, splayed legs and a loose rail. One neighbor braces that same loose rail with a clearly owned hand while the other's hand turns a screwdriver whose metal TIP actually meets the fastener at the rail joint. Separate hands, readable grip and contact. Right shirt has an identifiable collar and both sleeves, a visible small tear, a few repair stitches. One neighbor holds fabric on either side of that tear; the other grips a thin needle at the tear, with a short visible thread under modest tension. Both paired repair contacts should be substantial and readable, not tiny illustrations.

Design the scene and real copy together. Bent heads and inward arms open a gently narrowing, softly sunlit interval at center, becoming the active bench plane below. The table edge remains visible OUTSIDE the paragraph with a soft photographic tonal transition above it, no blank rectangular panel or empty room serving as a text board. Keep fine wood and light continuous behind the text, quiet enough for ink contrast; avoid text over fingers, faces, chair joint or shirt tear. The central explanation takes priority over an oversized headline. The lower information begins beyond the chair's outer leg. Faces, bodies, chair and shirt meaningfully organize this opening.

Type is dark deep indigo-charcoal, perfectly flat horizontal printed overlay, no surface perspective or distortion. Invitation title follows the gap between upper bent heads: open relatively light modern Korean display, generous counters, natural broad syllable proportions, finely controlled even strokes, clear word gaps. A compact medium Latin register directly beneath it. Then the regular proposition introduces a coherent THREE-LINE paragraph with stable left alignment, comfortable mature medium-optical Korean body, approximately the guide's body scale (readable about 18 px at 720-wide social view), uncompressed glyphs, open counters, intact Korean compound words and natural spaces. Precise Latin/numeral weight and baseline, punctuation visibly distinguished, no texturing or handwriting in the explanation. Do not make the paragraph a small caption. Its last learning phrase adjoins workshop identity. The left optical edge descends gently left through the workshop identity and date, then becomes nearly vertical for venue, fee, deadline, object invitation and URL. Date and time are one short horizontal row with a clear gap and no invented separator. Other entries continue on the same spine. Registration entries end as one adjoining run. Maintain generous yet connected leading and safe margins, legible full explanation and all event details at usage size.

Print ONLY the following copy, each entry exactly ONCE, preserving Korean/Latin letterforms, numbers, case, meaningful word spaces and exact punctuation. The paragraph below has soft line wraps, not separate entries. No extra headings, labels, logos, QR, watermark, signs or microprint:
